concepts.gloss_en: The rectification of the aspect of 'zaken' (the beard/elder); in Torah lm2:4 identified with the aspect of Shavuot

members.form: נתתקן בחינת זקן, שהוא בחינת שבועות
members.note: same clause in same Torah (lm2:4), longer form simply appends the predicate 'which is the aspect of Shavuot' identifying it — same head/subject, not a distinct concept

notes: The added clause 'שהוא בחינת שבועות' is an in-context equation (zaken = Shavuot in Torah lm2:4), not a change of the possessed/construct head. Both refer to the same 'rectification of the aspect of zaken.' If the reviewer treats the Shavuot equation as a separate node, split accordingly.
